lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤਿਅਹ ਕਹਤੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਰਹਤ ਕੋ ਖੁਸੀ ਨ ਆਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahatiah kahatee sunee rahat ko khusee na aayau ||
lines.translation: I listened to preachers and teachers, but I could not be happy with their lifestyles.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam chhod doojai lage tinh ke gun hau kiaa kahau ||
lines.translation: Those who have abandoned the Lord's Name, and become attached to duality - why should I speak in praise of them?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਯਿ ਮਿਲਾਯਉ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਜਿਵ ਤੂ ਰਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਰਹਉ ॥੨॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: gur day milaayau bhikhiaa jiv too rakhahi tiv rahau ||2||20||
lines.translation: So speaks Bhikhaa: the Lord has led me to meet the Guru. As You keep me, I remain; as You protect me, I survive. ||2||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਨਾਹੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਹੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਚੜਿਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahir samaadh sanaahu giaan hai aasan chaRiau ||
lines.translation: Wearing the armor of Samaadhi, the Guru has mounted the saddled horse of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੰਮ ਧਨਖੁ ਕਰ ਗਹਿਓ ਭਗਤ ਸੀਲਹ ਸਰਿ ਲੜਿਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhra(n)m dhanakh kar gahio bhagat seelah sar laRiau ||
lines.translation: Holding the bow of Dharma in His Hands, He has shot the arrows of devotion and humility.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਅਟਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਨੇਜਾ ਗਡਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai nirabhau har atal man sabad gur nejaa gadio ||
lines.translation: He is fearless in the Fear of the Eternal Lord God; He has thrust the spear of the Word of the Guru's Shabad into the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਪਤੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਬਿਖੰਡਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh moh apat pa(n)ch doot bikha(n)dio ||
lines.translation: He has cut down the five demons of unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger, unsatisfied greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲਉ ਭੂਹਾਲੁ ਤੇਜੋ ਤਨਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhalau bhoohaal tejo tanaa nripat naath naanak bar ||
lines.translation: Guru Amar Daas, the son of Tayj Bhaan, of the noble Bhalla dynasty, blessed by Guru Nanak, is the Master of kings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਸਚੁ ਸਲੵ ਭਣਿ ਤੈ ਦਲੁ ਜਿਤਉ ਇਵ ਜੁਧੁ ਕਰਿ ॥੧॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur amaradaas sach saly bhan tai dal jitau iv judh kar ||1||21||
lines.translation: SALL speaks the truth; O Guru Amar Daas, you have conquered the army of evil, fighting the battle this way. ||1||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਨਹਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਸੁਅ ਰੋਮਾਵਲਿ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਸੰਤ ਗਨੰਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghanahar boo(n)d basu romaaval kusam basa(n)t gana(n)t na aavai ||
lines.translation: The raindrops of the clouds, the plants of the earth, and the flowers of the spring cannot be counted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੋ ਗੰਗ ਤਰੰਗ ਅੰਤੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: rav sas kiran udar saagar ko ga(n)g tara(n)g a(n)t ko paavai ||
lines.translation: Who can know the limits of the rays of the sun and the moon, the waves of the ocean and the Ganges?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਕਬਿ ਜਨ ਭਲੵ ਉਨਹ ਜੋੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: rudr dhiaan giaan satigur ke kab jan bhaly unah jou gaavai ||
lines.translation: With Shiva's meditation and the spiritual wisdom of the True Guru, says BHALL the poet, these may be counted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲੇ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੋਹਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhale amaradaas gun tere teree upamaa tohi ban aavai ||1||22||
lines.translation: O Guru Amar Daas, Your Glorious Virtues are so sublime; Your Praises belong only to You. ||1||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਚਉਥੇ ਕੇ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: savaeee mahale chauthe ke 4 ||
lines.translation: Swaiyas In Praise Of The Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik man purakh nira(n)jan dhiaavau ||
lines.translation: Meditate single-mindedly on the Immaculate Primal Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad har gun sad gaavau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat man hoi bigaasaa ||
lines.translation: Singing His Praises, the mind blossoms forth in ecstasy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਨਹ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur poor janah kee aasaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru fulfills the hopes of His humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev param pad paayau ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the supreme status is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਧਿਆਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: abinaasee abigat dhiaayau ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Imperishable, Formless Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਚੰਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis bhete daaridr na cha(n)pai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with Him, one escapes poverty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲੵ ਸਹਾਰੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਜੰਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaly sahaar taas gun ja(n)pai ||
lines.translation: Kal Sahaar chants His Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਪਉ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਮਲ ਸੁਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੇ ਅਮਿਅ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)pau gun bimal sujan jan kere ami naam jaa kau phuriaa ||
lines.translation: I chant the pure praises of that humble being who has been blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਬਦ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਯਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: in satagur sev sabad ras paayaa naam nira(n)jan ur dhariaa ||
lines.translation: He served the True Guru and was blessed with the sublime essence of the Shabad, the Word of God. The Immaculate Naam has been enshrined in his heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿਕੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਚਾਹਕੁ ਤਤ ਸਮਤ ਸਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam rasik gobi(n)d gun gaahak chaahak tat samat sare ||
lines.translation: He enjoys and savors the Lord's Name, and purchases the Glorious Virtues of the Lord of the Universe. He seeks the essence of reality; he is the Fountain of even-handed justice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kav kaly thakur haradaas tane gur raamadaas sar abhar bhare ||1||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੁਟਤ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਅਮਿਅ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਸਦ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhutat paravaah ami amaraa pad a(n)mrit sarovar sad bhariaa ||
lines.translation: The stream of ambrosial nectar flows and the immortal status is obtained; the pool is forever overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਪੁਬ ਜਿਨਹੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: te peevahi sa(n)t karahi man majan pub jinahu sevaa kareeaa ||
lines.translation: Those Saints who have served the Lord in the past drink in this Nectar, and bathe their minds in it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਅਨਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਸਬਦ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin bhau nivaar anabhai pad deenaa sabad maatr te udhar dhare ||
lines.translation: God takes their fears away, and blesses them with the state of fearless dignity. Through the Word of His Shabad, He has saved them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kav kaly thakur haradaas tane gur raamadaas sar abhar bhare ||2||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਗੂੜੑ ਬਿਮਲ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੁ ਭਯਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur mat gooRh bimal satasa(n)gat aatam ra(n)g chalool bhayaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru's understanding is deep and profound. The Sat Sangat is His Pure Congregation. His Soul is drenched in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗੵਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਵਲੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਰਕਾਸੵਾ ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਘਰਹਿ ਲਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaagyaa man kaval sahaj parakaasyaa abhai nira(n)jan gharahi lahaa ||
lines.translation: The Lotus of His mind remains awake and aware, illuminated with intuitive wisdom. In His own home, He has obtained the Fearless, Immaculate Lord.
